name: Paramo
notes: High-Andean paramo (Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador, N Peru) above cloud forest: humid, giant-rosette frailejones, tussock grasses, cushion bogs and dwarf shrubs; Espeletia in the north, Puya and Chusquea widespread.
